_purpose: Durable engine/addon pin for Blocktower W1. tools/test.ps1 verifies the engine binary hash, the GUT plugin version and the GUT source manifest hash against this file. The original 2026-09-20 preflight provenance is preserved unchanged at docs/pretests/results/engine_provenance_2026-09-20.json and docs/pretests/results/gut_compatibility_2026-09-20.json.

engine.name: Godot Engine
engine.copy_verification: SHA-256 of the zip and both executables computed at the temp source and again at the durable copy; all three pairs identical. '--version' from the durable console executable printed the pinned version with exit code 0.
engine.note: 2026-09-21 W5 follow-up: matching 4.7.2 Android debug/release export templates installed after official SHA512 verification; see docs/implementation/W5_Device_Interim_Report_2026-09-21.md

gut.name: GUT (Godot Unit Test)
gut.preflight_archive_note: Archive hash as recorded by the 2026-09-20 preflight; the archive was not retained, so W1 pins the extracted source tree instead.
gut.source_manifest_rule: All files under game/addons/gut except *.import and *.uid. One line per file: '<relative path with forward slashes> <sha256 lowercase>'. Lines sorted by ordinal byte order, joined with LF, trailing LF, UTF-8; SHA-256 of that text. Computed identically by tools/common.ps1 Get-GutManifestHash and by bash (find | LC_ALL=C sort | sha256sum). Both produced this value on 2026-09-21.
gut.editor_generated_files_note: *.uid and *.import files are tracked in git for stable references but excluded from the pin because the editor may regenerate them.
